questions.question_english: The funding pattern for the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste (SC) students between the Central Government and State Governments (other than North Eastern states) was revised by the Union Cabinet. What is the currently established fixed sharing ratio?
questions.explanation_english: The Union Cabinet approved a landmark revision in the Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC students (PMS-SC), implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. Under the revised framework, the earlier unpredictable 'committed liability' formula was replaced with a fixed sharing pattern of 60:40 between the Centre and the States/UTs with legislature (for North Eastern States and Himalayan States, the sharing ratio is 90:10, and for UTs without legislature, it is 100% Central funding). This reform ensures stable central budgetary support, removes financial uncertainty for state departments, and facilitates direct benefit transfers (DBT) of scholarship amounts directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of SC students.
questions.explanation_hindi: केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल द्वारा सामाजिक न्याय एवं अधिकारिता मंत्रालय के अधीन संचालित अनुसूचित जातियों के छात्रों के लिए केंद्र प्रायोजित मैट्रिकोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति योजना (PMS-SC) के वित्तपोषण पैटर्न में महत्वपूर्ण संशोधन किया गया। इस संशोधित व्यवस्था के तहत पुरानी 'प्रतिबद्ध देयता' (Committed Liability) प्रणाली को समाप्त कर केंद्र और राज्यों/केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों (विधानसभा सहित) के मध्य 60:40 का एक निश्चित वित्तीय सहभाजन अनुपात (Fixed Sharing Ratio) निर्धारित किया गया। पूर्वोत्तर और हिमालयी राज्यों के लिए यह अनुपात 90:10 है तथा बिना विधानसभा वाले केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों के लिए यह 100% केंद्रीय वित्तपोषित है। इस सुधार का उद्देश्य राज्यों की वित्तीय अनिश्चितता को दूर करना तथा प्रत्यक्ष लाभ अंतरण (DBT) के माध्यम से छात्रों के आधार-संबद्ध बैंक खातों में समयबद्ध वित्तीय सहायता सुनिश्चित करना है।

पुराने दर पर टीडीएस कटौती जारी रखते हुए शिक्षक को आयकर विभाग से सीधे रिफंड का दावा करने का निर्देश दें।

स्कूल के आकस्मिक कोष से कर्मचारी को अब तक काटा गया अतिरिक्त टीडीएस तुरंत वापस कर दें।

questions.question_english: A Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) estimates the annual income of a teacher and deducts TDS on a monthly basis. In the month of January, the teacher submits documentary proofs of tax-saving investments (under Chapter VI-A) that were previously declared in April but not documented. What is the legally prescribed course of action for the DDO?
options_english: Reject the proofs outright because they were not submitted in April at the beginning of the financial year.
Instruct the teacher to claim a refund directly from the Income Tax Department while continuing TDS deduction at the earlier rate.
Re-calculate the total estimated tax liability using the verified proofs and adjust the remaining monthly TDS deductions accordingly.
Immediately refund the excess TDS deducted so far directly to the employee from the school's contingency fund.
questions.explanation_english:
Under Section 192(3) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, the DDO has the legal authority to adjust any excess or deficiency in TDS deductions across subsequent months of the financial year.

Key administrative procedures:
1. At the beginning of the financial year (April/May), employees submit an investment declaration based on which estimated TDS is deducted on an average monthly rate.
2. Around December/January, employees submit actual documentary evidence and payment receipts (e.g., PPF, LIC, ELSS, tuition fees under Section 80C, mediclaim under Section 80D).
3. Upon receiving verified proofs, the DDO re-computes the employee's total annual taxable income and tax liability.
4. The DDO then adjusts the remaining tax to be deducted in equal installments over the remaining months (January, February, and March).

The DDO cannot refund TDS from school funds because deducted tax has already been credited to the Central Government.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 192(3) के तहत, DDO को वित्तीय वर्ष के शेष महीनों में टीडीएस कटौती में किसी भी अधिकता या कमी को समायोजित करने का वैधानिक अधिकार प्राप्त है।

प्रमुख प्रशासनिक प्रक्रियाएँ:
1. वित्तीय वर्ष के प्रारंभ (अप्रैल/मई) में, कर्मचारी एक निवेश घोषणा प्रस्तुत करते हैं जिसके आधार पर औसत मासिक दर से अनुमानित टीडीएस काटा जाता है।
2. दिसंबर/जनवरी के आसपास, कर्मचारी वास्तविक दस्तावेजी साक्ष्य और रसीदें (जैसे पीपीएफ, एलआईसी, ईएलएसएस, धारा 80C के तहत ट्यूशन फीस, धारा 80D के तहत मेडिक्लेम) जमा करते हैं।
3. सत्यापित साक्ष्य प्राप्त होने पर, DDO कर्मचारी की कुल वार्षिक कर योग्य आय और कर देयता की पुनर्गणना करता है।
4. इसके बाद DDO शेष महीनों (जनवरी, फरवरी और मार्च) के दौरान काटे जाने वाले शेष कर को समान किस्तों में समायोजित करता है।

DDO स्कूल फंड से टीडीएस रिफंड नहीं कर सकता क्योंकि काटा गया कर पहले ही केंद्र सरकार के खाते में जमा कराया जा चुका होता है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Re-calculate estimated tax with valid proofs and adjust remaining monthly TDS deductions.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: and adjust remaining monthly TDS deductions. When an employee submits valid documentary evidence of tax-saving investments during the financial year, the Drawing and Disbursing Officer is required to re-compute the total estimated tax liability. The remaining tax to be deducted for the balance months of the financial year should be adjusted accordingly to reflect the updated eligible deductions.

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): If an employee fails to furnish their valid Permanent Account Number (PAN) to the employer, the DDO is legally mandated to deduct TDS at the rate of 20% or the normal applicable slab rate, whichever is higher.
Reason (R): Section 206AA of the Income Tax Act, 1961 prescribes a higher penal rate of TDS for non-furnishing of PAN to ensure tax transparency and compliance.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true but (R) is false
(A) is false but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english:
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, and Reason (R) is the exact statutory explanation for Assertion (A).

1. Section 206AA of the Income Tax Act, 1961 provides that any person entitled to receive any sum on which tax is deductible under Chapter XVII-B must furnish their PAN to the deductor. If they fail to do so, tax shall be deducted at the highest of the following rates:
   - At the rate specified in the relevant provision of the Act;
   - At the rate or rates in force; or
   - At the rate of 20%.
2. In the case of salary income under Section 192, if the applicable slab rate (e.g. 30%) exceeds 20%, tax is deducted at that higher slab rate. If the average rate is less than 20%, tax must be deducted at minimum 20%.
3. Furthermore, no tax exemption or lower deduction certificate under Section 197 is valid without PAN.
4. Hence, Reason (R) correctly explains Assertion (A).
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सटीक वैधानिक व्याख्या है।

1. आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 206AA प्रावधान करती है कि अध्याय XVII-B के तहत कटौती योग्य राशि प्राप्त करने वाले प्रत्येक व्यक्ति को कटौतीकर्ता को अपना पैन (PAN) प्रस्तुत करना होगा। ऐसा न करने पर, निम्नलिखित में से जो भी दर सबसे अधिक हो, उस पर कर काटा जाएगा:
   - अधिनियम के प्रासंगिक प्रावधान में निर्दिष्ट दर पर;
   - लागू दर या दरों पर; अथवा
   - 20% की दर पर।
2. धारा 192 के तहत वेतन के मामले में, यदि लागू स्लैब दर (उदा. 30%) 20% से अधिक है, तो उस उच्च स्लैब दर पर कटौती होगी; यदि औसत दर 20% से कम है, तो न्यूनतम 20% की दर से टीडीएस काटा जाएगा।
3. इसके अतिरिक्त, धारा 197 के तहत कम कटौती या शून्य कटौती का प्रमाण पत्र भी बिना पैन के मान्य नहीं होता।
4. अतः कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।

questions.question_english: Under Section 4(2)(a) of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act), who must compulsorily be nominated as the Presiding Officer of the Internal Committee (IC/ICC)?
options_english: The Head of the Institution or school Principal holding administrative charge
An external NGO representative dedicated to women's welfare
A senior-level woman employee at the workplace
The senior-most male employee available in the establishment
questions.explanation_english:
Under Section 4(2)(a) of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act), the Internal Committee (IC/ICC) must be headed by a Presiding Officer who shall be a woman employed at a senior level at the workplace from amongst the employees. The objective is to provide a safe, accessible, and empathetic forum headed by a senior woman leader.

Proviso to Section 4(2)(a): In case a senior-level woman employee is not available at the particular workplace or office, the Presiding Officer must be nominated from other administrative units, branches, or offices of the same organization. If no senior woman is available across other offices either, she may be nominated from another department or organization under the same employer.

In the context of school education administration, even though the Principal is the administrative and academic head of the institution, if the Principal is male, he cannot be appointed as the Presiding Officer; instead, a senior woman teacher/faculty member or administrative officer must be designated. Therefore, option (C) is the legally correct answer.
questions.explanation_hindi:
कार्यस्थल पर महिलाओं का लैंगिक उत्पीड़न (निवारण, प्रतिषेध एवं प्रतितोष) अधिनियम, 2013 (पॉश अधिनियम) की धारा 4(2)(a) के अनुसार, आंतरिक शिकायत समिति (ICC) का पीठासीन अधिकारी (प्रिसाइडिंग ऑफिसर) कार्यस्थल पर कर्मचारियों में से वरिष्ठ स्तर पर कार्यरत एक महिला कर्मचारी होगी। इस विधिक प्रावधान का मुख्य उद्देश्य पीड़ित महिलाओं को एक सुरक्षित, निष्पक्ष और संवेदनशील मंच प्रदान करना है जिसका नेतृत्व एक वरिष्ठ महिला द्वारा किया जाए।

धारा 4(2)(a) का परंतुक (Proviso) यह स्पष्ट करता है कि यदि संबंधित कार्यस्थल/शाखा में वरिष्ठ स्तर की महिला कर्मचारी उपलब्ध न हो, तो संगठन के अन्य प्रशासनिक कार्यालयों या इकाइयों से वरिष्ठ महिला को नामित किया जाएगा। यदि वहां भी कोई उपयुक्त महिला उपलब्ध न हो, तो उसी नियोक्ता के किसी अन्य विभाग या संगठन से महिला अधिकारी को नामित किया जाएगा।

विद्यालयी प्रशासनिक संदर्भ में, भले ही प्रधानाचार्य संस्थान के प्रशासनिक प्रमुख हों, यदि प्रधानाचार्य पुरुष हैं, तो वे आंतरिक समिति के पीठासीन अधिकारी नहीं बन सकते; विद्यालय की किसी वरिष्ठ महिला शिक्षिका/अधिकारी को ही पीठासीन अधिकारी नियुक्त किया जाना अनिवार्य है। अतः विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) A senior-level woman employee at the workplace

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: workplace Section 4(2)(a) mandates that the Presiding Officer of the Internal Complaints Committee must be a woman employed at a senior level at the workplace. If a senior woman is unavailable at the specific location, she must be nominated from other administrative units or offices belonging to the same organization or employer.

questions.question_hindi: यदि RTI आवेदन में काल्पनिक प्रश्न पूछा जाए या ऐसी राय/सलाह माँगी जाए जो अभिलेखों में मौजूद ही न हो, तो PIO का दायित्व क्या है?
options_hindi: PIO को विभागाध्यक्ष से परामर्श करके राय तैयार करनी होगी
PIO को आवेदन विशेषज्ञ राय बनाने के लिए कानूनी विभाग को भेजना होगा

PIO को ऐसी राय या सलाह देने की बाध्यता नहीं है जो अभिलेख में उपलब्ध न हो
questions.question_english: What happens when an RTI application asks a hypothetical question or seeks the “opinion” or “advice” of the PIO on a matter where no such recorded opinion exists in the files?
options_english: The PIO is required to generate the opinion after formal consultation with the Head of Department.
The PIO must immediately transfer the application to the legal department for expert formulation.

The PIO is not obliged to offer opinions or advice not available on record.
questions.explanation_english: The PIO is not obliged to offer opinions or advice not available on record. The Right to Information Act covers information that is held in recorded form by a public authority. A Public Information Officer is required to supply existing records and data, but is under no legal obligation to generate fresh opinions, create hypothetical answers, or provide legal advice that does not exist in recorded official files.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है: PIO को ऐसी राय या सलाह देने की बाध्यता नहीं है जो अभिलेख में उपलब्ध न हो। RTI के अंतर्गत उपलब्ध या अभिलेख में दर्ज सूचना दी जाती है; लोक प्राधिकरण को नई राय, कारण या विश्लेषण तैयार करना सामान्यतः आवश्यक नहीं होता।

अभिकथन (A): CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965 के नियम 10 के अंतर्गत सरकारी कर्मचारी का निलंबन नियम 11 के अर्थ में दंड नहीं है।
कारण (R): निलंबन के दौरान नियोक्ता-कर्मचारी संबंध अस्थायी रूप से स्थगित रहता है, जबकि कर्मचारी पद पर अपना अधिकार बनाए रखता है और उसे निर्वाह भत्ता मिलता है।
options_hindi: A और R दोनों सही हैं तथा R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Suspension of a Government servant under Rule 10 is not considered a penalty under Rule 11 of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965.
Reason (R): Suspension merely suspends the employer-employee relationship temporarily while the employee retains a lien on the post and receives a subsistence allowance.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A Suspension under Rule 10 is an administrative measure rather than a statutory penalty under Rule 11. During suspension, the employer- employee relationship is held in abeyance while the employee retains a lien on the post and receives a subsistence allowance, preventing suspension from being legally treated as a punishment or penalty.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर A है। नियम 10 के अंतर्गत निलंबन प्रशासनिक उपाय है, जबकि नियम 11 वैधानिक दंडों की सूची देता है। निलंबन की अवधि में कर्मचारी का सेवा-संबंध अस्थायी रूप से निष्क्रिय रहता है, लेकिन पद पर उसका अधिकार बना रहता है और उसे निर्वाह भत्ता मिल सकता है। इसलिए निलंबन को स्वयं दंड नहीं माना जाता, और कारण अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है।
key_facts: उत्तर-कुंजी: (A)
नियम 10 के अंतर्गत निलंबन प्रशासनिक उपाय है, जबकि नियम 11 वैधानिक दंडों की सूची देता है

questions.question_english: If a state government wants to modify the minimum qualifications for teachers laid down by the NCTE due to a severe shortage of qualified candidates, it must:
options_english: Request Central Government relaxation of norms for up to five years.
Issue an official state gazette notification altering teacher qualification norms independently.
File an urgent petition asking the High Court for administrative permission to modify norms.
Modify recruitment qualification norms through internal administrative orders secretly.
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 23(2), if a state lacks sufficient teacher training institutions or qualified candidates, the State Government cannot alter qualifications independently. It must submit a formal request to the Central Government to grant a temporary relaxation of minimum qualification norms for up to five years.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प A है। शिक्षक नियुक्ति की न्यूनतम योग्यताएँ NCTE द्वारा निर्धारित की जाती हैं और संबंधित कानून/नियमों के अनुसार छूट की प्रक्रिया केंद्र सरकार से जुड़ी हो सकती है। राज्य सरकार स्वयं इन मानकों को एकतरफा बदल नहीं सकती। न्यायालय से सामान्य अनुमति माँगना या गोपनीय प्रशासनिक आदेश जारी करना वैधानिक प्रक्रिया का विकल्प नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Request Central Government relaxation of norms for up to five years.

Under Section 23(2), if a state lacks sufficient teacher training institutions or qualified candidates, the State Government cannot alter qualifications independently. It must submit a formal request to the Central Government to grant a temporary relaxation of minimum qualification norms for up to five years.

questions.question_english: What is the main purpose of the Leave Travel Concession (LTC) available to Government servants?
options_english: To enable travel to the employee’s Home Town and across India for rest and recreation
To provide financial assistance for international tourism and official travel abroad
To compensate for the lack of medical facilities at the employee’s place of posting

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statutory compliance deadlines in an annual compliance calendar for Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on salaries under the Income Tax Act:
I. Deposit of TDS (April to February): By the 7th of the following month
II. Deposit of TDS (March): By 30th April
III. Filing Quarter 4 TDS return (Form 24Q): By 31st May
IV. Issuing TDS Certificate (Form 16) to employees: By 15th June
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II, and III only
II, III, and IV only
I, III, and IV only
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 30 and Rule 31A of the Income-tax Rules, 1962, the statutory deadlines for salary TDS compliance are as follows:
1. Deposit of TDS (Rule 30): Tax deducted from April to February must be deposited into the government account on or before the 7th day of the immediately following month. For tax deducted in the month of March, the statutory deposit deadline is 30th April.
2. Filing Quarterly TDS Return (Rule 31A): Form 24Q for Quarter 4 (ending March 31) must be filed by 31st May of the financial year immediately following the financial year in which the deduction is made.
3. Issuing Form 16 (Rule 31): The annual TDS certificate in Form 16 (Part A and Part B) must be furnished to employees on or before 15th June of the following financial year.
Since all four statutory statements are correct, Option D is the right answer.

questions.question_english: Under the POCSO Act and Rules, what is the statutory role of a 'support person' assigned to assist a child victim?
options_english: A licensed criminal lawyer who formally defends the accused person in court
A person trained to assist the child during pre-trial and trial processes
A designated police officer who provides continuous security to the child
A official financial guarantor for all of the child's medical expenses
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 4 and Rule 5 of the POCSO Rules, 2020 (framed under Section 45 of the POCSO Act, 2012), the Child Welfare Committee (CWC) assigns a 'Support Person' to assist a child victim throughout the legal process. A support person is typically a trained social worker, counselor, psychologist, or representative of a child protection organization. Their role is to provide psychological, emotional, and practical support to the child during statement recording (Sections 24 and 26 POCSO, Section 164 CrPC), medical examination (Section 27), and trial before the Special Court. They ensure the child understands proceedings in an age-appropriate manner, coordinate with the Special Public Prosecutor, and prevent secondary victimization or trauma during judicial interactions.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the operation of a post-based reservation roster:
I. The number of reserved points in the roster is directly proportionate to the prescribed statutory percentage of reservation.
II. The roster operates continuously and infinitely, without being limited or squeezed to the sanctioned cadre strength.
III. Once the prescribed number of reserved posts in a cadre is fully occupied, the roster becomes temporarily inoperative for that category until a corresponding vacancy arises.
Which of the statements given above correctly describe the post-based roster system?
options_english: I and II only
I and III only
II and III only
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english:
Under the post-based roster system established pursuant to the R.K. Sabharwal judgment (1995) and DoPT OM dated 2nd July 1997: 
1. Statement I is correct: Points in the roster are earmarked strictly to reflect the exact percentage of reservation prescribed for SC (15%), ST (7.5%), OBC (27%), and EWS (10%).
2. Statement II is incorrect: A post-based roster does NOT run infinitely. It is strictly bounded, mapped, and squeezed to the total sanctioned cadre strength (number of posts) in that specific cadre. 
3. Statement III is correct: Once the quota for a reserved category has reached the sanctioned ceiling within the cadre, the reservation roster stops operating for that category. Future appointments cannot be made from that reserved category against unreserved vacancies until an incumbent of that reserved category vacates a post. Hence, statements I and III are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आर.के. सभरवाल निर्णय (1995) और 2 जुलाई 1997 के DoPT कार्यालय ज्ञापन के तहत पद-आधारित रोस्टर प्रणाली के अनुसार:
1. कथन I सही है: रोस्टर में आरक्षित बिंदुओं की संख्या संबंधित श्रेणियों (SC-15%, ST-7.5%, OBC-27%, EWS-10%) के लिए निर्धारित वैधानिक प्रतिशत के अनुपात में होती है।
2. कथन II गलत है: पद-आधारित रोस्टर अनंत रूप से नहीं चलता, बल्कि यह संवर्ग के कुल स्वीकृत पदों (cadre strength) तक ही सीमित और आबद्ध (squeezed) होता है।

questions.question_english: How many specified disabilities are recognized under the Schedule of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016?
questions.explanation_english: The Schedule to the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016 recognizes 21 specified disabilities, substantially expanding the coverage from the 7 conditions recognized under the repealed Persons with Disabilities Act, 1995. The 21 categories include physical disabilities (locomotor disability, leprosy cured, cerebral palsy, dwarfism, muscular dystrophy, acid attack victims, blindness, low-vision, deaf, hard of hearing, speech and language disability), intellectual disabilities (specific learning disabilities, autism spectrum disorder), mental illness, chronic neurological conditions (multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease), blood disorders (haemophilia, thalassemia, sickle cell disease), and multiple disabilities. Under Section 56, the Central Government also possesses the statutory power to notify additional conditions.
questions.explanation_hindi: दिव्यांगजन अधिकार अधिनियम, 2016 की अनुसूची के तहत कुल 21 विनिर्दिष्ट दिव्यांगताओं को मान्यता प्रदान की गई है, जो कि 1995 के पुराने कानून में मान्यता प्राप्त 7 दिव्यांगताओं से तीन गुना अधिक है। इन 21 श्रेणियों में शारीरिक अक्षमताएँ (चलन दिव्यांगता, कुष्ठ रोग मुक्त, सेरेब्रल पाल्सी, बौनापन, मस्कुलर डिस्ट्रॉफी, एसिड अटैक पीड़ित, दृष्टिहीनता, अल्प दृष्टि, बधिर, श्रवण बाधित, वाक् एवं भाषा दिव्यांगता), बौद्धिक अक्षमता (विशिष्ट अधिगम अक्षमता, ऑटिज्म स्पेक्ट्रम), मानसिक रुग्णता, दीर्घकालिक तंत्रिका संबंधी विकार (मल्टीपल स्केलेरोसिस, पार्किंसंस रोग), रक्त विकार (हीमोफिलिया, थैलेसीमिया, सिकल सेल रोग) और बहु-दिव्यांगता शामिल हैं। धारा 56 के तहत केंद्र सरकार नई दिव्यांगताओं को जोड़ने हेतु अधिकृत है।

questions.question_english: If a government school teacher belonging to a Scheduled Caste files a grievance alleging denial of legitimate promotion due to caste bias, which constitutional body is vested with the powers of a civil court to investigate and monitor all matters relating to the safeguards provided for the Scheduled Castes?
options_english: Central Administrative Tribunal of the State
National Commission for Scheduled Castes
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
National Human Rights Commission of India
questions.explanation_english: Article 338 of the Constitution of India establishes the National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC). Under Article 338(5), the Commission has the duty to investigate and monitor all matters relating to the safeguards provided for the Scheduled Castes under the Constitution or any other law, and to inquire into specific complaints with respect to the deprivation of rights and safeguards of the Scheduled Castes. Under Article 338(8), while investigating any matter or inquiring into any complaint relating to denial of promotion, harassment, or roster tampering involving an SC employee, the Commission is vested with all the powers of a Civil Court trying a suit under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. This includes summoning and enforcing the attendance of witnesses, examining them on oath, discovery and production of documents, and requisitioning public records from any school or education directorate.
questions.explanation_hindi: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 338 के तहत 'राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जाति आयोग' (NCSC) एक उच्च स्तरीय संवैधानिक निकाय के रूप में स्थापित किया गया है। अनुच्छेद 338(5) के अनुसार, आयोग का यह प्रमुख कर्तव्य है कि वह अनुसूचित जातियों के लिए संविधान या किसी अन्य कानून के तहत प्रदान किए गए सभी सुरक्षा उपायों से संबंधित मामलों की निगरानी व जांच करे तथा उनके अधिकारों के हनन संबंधी शिकायतों की सुनवाई करे। अनुच्छेद 338(8) के अंतर्गत किसी भी मामले की जांच करते समय आयोग को सिविल प्रक्रिया संहिता, 1908 के तहत दीवानी अदालत (Civil Court) की शक्तियां प्राप्त होती हैं, जैसे गवाहों को समन भेजना, शपथ पर बयान लेना, रोस्टर रजिस्टर या पदोन्नति से संबंधित गोपनीय दस्तावेजों को मंगाना। अतः पदोन्नति में जातिगत भेदभाव की जांच हेतु राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जाति आयोग सही निकाय है। विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) National Commission for Scheduled Castes

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Article 338 of the Constitution of India, the National Commission for Scheduled Castes is vested with the powers of a civil court. It investigates individual grievances alleging denial of safeguards, examines caste-based discrimination complaints in promotion or recruitment, and monitors the implementation of constitutional protections guaranteed for Scheduled Castes. questions.question_english: A teacher informs the DDO that they have an additional income of ₹50,000 from Bank Fixed Deposits and requests that tax on it be deducted at source from their salary. What should the DDO do under the Income Tax Act?
options_english: Reject the request as bank interest TDS must be deducted exclusively by the concerned commercial bank
Direct the employee to obtain a formal No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Income Tax Department
Advise the employee to deposit Advance Tax independently instead of adjusting through salary TDS
Include this ₹50,000 under 'Income from Other Sources' in the tax computation and deduct TDS accordingly
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 192(2B) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, a salaried employee is statutorily entitled to declare to the DDO any income chargeable under any other head of income (such as 'Income from Other Sources', including bank interest or dividend income). Upon receiving such a written declaration from the employee, the DDO is legally required to take this additional income into account while computing total taxable income and deduct the appropriate higher TDS from the monthly salary. However, the DDO cannot take into account any loss under other heads except under the head 'Income from House Property'.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर D है। आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 192(2B) के प्रावधानों के तहत, एक वेतनभोगी कर्मचारी को यह अधिकार प्राप्त है कि वह अन्य शीर्षों (जैसे बैंक ब्याज, लाभांश आदि) से होने वाली किसी भी आय का विवरण अपने DDO को दे सकता है। ऐसी घोषणा प्राप्त होने पर, DDO उस ₹50,000 को कर्मचारी की कुल कर योग्य आय में 'अन्य स्रोतों से आय' के रूप में जोड़ेगा और वित्तीय वर्ष के शेष महीनों के वेतन से तदनुसार टीडीएस की उच्चतर राशि काटेगा।

questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 138 of the CGST Rules, 2017, an Electronic Way Bill (E-way Bill) is a mandatory electronically generated document that must accompany any consignment of goods valued above ₹50,000 being moved from one place to another. The E-way Bill is generated on the common GST portal (ewaybillgst.gov.in) by the supplier, recipient, or transporter prior to dispatch. It contains details of the consignor, consignee, HSN code, invoice number, value, and vehicle details, ensuring tracking and indirect tax compliance during transit.

questions.question_english: In the recruitment of school teachers (such as PRT, TGT, and PGT) under the Government of NCT of Delhi (GNCTD) and central educational autonomous bodies, what is the quantum of relaxation provided in the qualifying cut-off marks of the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) for SC, ST, OBC, and PwBD candidates?
questions.explanation_english: Under the guidelines issued by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) and the CBSE CTET examination rules, a general category candidate must score at least 60% (90 marks out of a total 150) to qualify the CTET. However, the guidelines expressly empower recruiting authorities and school managements to grant qualifying mark concessions to candidates belonging to reserved categories. Accordingly, the Directorate of Education, GNCTD / DSSSB and central bodies (such as KVS and NVS) grant a 5% relaxation in qualifying marks to candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC, and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). This reduces the qualifying passing score for these reserved categories from 60% (90 marks) to 55% (82.5 or 82 marks out of 150).

key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) 5%

questions.question_english: A candidate applying for an educational or administrative post under the EWS quota submits an Income and Asset Certificate. Which of the following residential property assets will automatically disqualify the candidate from claiming EWS status under Central Government guidelines?
options_english: A residential flat of 800 sq. ft.
A residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. and above
A residential plot of 80 sq. yards in a notified municipality
A residential plot of 150 sq. yards in areas other than notified municipalities
questions.explanation_english:
According to DoPT Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31 January 2019, specific residential asset thresholds lead to disqualification from the EWS category:

1. Residential Flat: A flat of 1000 sq. ft. and above is an absolute disqualifier. Therefore, an 800 sq. ft. flat is permissible (does not disqualify), but a flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more results in immediate exclusion.
2. Residential Plot in Notified Municipalities: The disqualifying limit is 100 sq. yards and above. An 80 sq. yard plot falls safely below the ceiling.
3. Residential Plot in Non-Notified Areas: The disqualifying limit is 200 sq. yards and above. A 150 sq. yard plot falls safely below the ceiling.

Thus, only the ownership of 'a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. and above' acts as an automatic statutory bar to claiming EWS reservation.
questions.explanation_hindi:
DoPT के 31 जनवरी 2019 के आधिकारिक दिशा-निर्देशों के अनुसार आवासीय संपत्तियों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित अपवर्जन सीमाएं निर्धारित हैं:

1. आवासीय फ्लैट: 1000 वर्ग फुट और उससे अधिक का आवासीय फ्लैट होने पर परिवार EWS आरक्षण के अयोग्य हो जाता है। अतः 800 वर्ग फुट का फ्लैट रखने वाला व्यक्ति अपात्र नहीं होता, किंतु 1000 वर्ग फुट या उससे अधिक का फ्लैट होने पर वह स्वतः अयोग्य हो जाता है।
2. अधिसूचित नगरपालिकाओं में आवासीय भूखंड: अयोग्यता की सीमा 100 वर्ग गज और उससे अधिक है (80 वर्ग गज का भूखंड सीमा के भीतर होने से पात्र है)।
3. अन्य क्षेत्रों (गैर-अधिसूचित) में आवासीय भूखंड: अयोग्यता की सीमा 200 वर्ग गज और उससे अधिक है (150 वर्ग गज का भूखंड सीमा के भीतर होने से पात्र है)।

अतः दिए गए विकल्पों में '1000 वर्ग फुट और उससे अधिक का आवासीय फ्लैट' उम्मीदवार को EWS दर्जे से सीधे अयोग्य घोषित कर देगा।
questions.topic: Constitutional Provisions for PwBD, EWS, SC, ST, and Disadvantaged Groups
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) A residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. and above

Ownership of a residential flat measuring 1000 square feet or above disqualifies a candidate and their family from claiming EWS status, irrespective of whether their total annual family income falls below the prescribed limit.

questions.question_english: A Government servant files an appeal against a penalty order. While the appeal is pending with the Appellate Authority, can the Revising Authority take up the case for revision?
options_english: Yes, revision proceedings and regular appeal proceedings can legally run concurrently without bar.
Yes, provided the Appellate Authority explicitly grants written consent to initiate revision.
No, revision cannot start until appeal time expires or the appeal is disposed of.
Yes, but such concurrent exercise of power can only be undertaken directly by the President.
questions.explanation_english: No, revision cannot start until appeal time expires or the appeal is disposed of. Under Rule 29(1), revision proceedings cannot be initiated while a regular departmental appeal against the penalty order is pending before the Appellate Authority or before the prescribed limitation period for filing an appeal has expired, maintaining orderly administrative remedy hierarchy and preventing conflicting concurrent proceedings.

questions.question_english: Which category of citizens is legally eligible to claim the benefit of 10% EWS reservation under the provisions of the 103rd Constitutional Amendment?
options_english: General (unreserved) category citizens who are not covered under existing SC, ST, and OBC reservation quotas
All citizens whose family income falls below the prescribed limit, including members of SC and ST communities
Citizens belonging exclusively to notified religious and linguistic minority communities
Existing regular government employees seeking accelerated promotional appointments
questions.explanation_english:
The text of the Explanation added to Article 15(6) and Article 16(6) by the 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019 explicitly clarifies that 'economically weaker sections' shall be such as may be notified by the State from time to time, but specifically applies to citizens other than those belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (OBCs) covered under Articles 15(4), 15(5), and 16(4).

In accordance with Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT) Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31 January 2019, persons who are not covered under the existing scheme of reservation for SCs, STs, and Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (OBCs) and whose family has gross annual income below Rs. 8.00 lakh are eligible for EWS reservation.

Therefore, members of SC, ST, and OBC categories cannot claim benefits under the EWS quota, preventing double-benefit entitlement under two separate vertical reservation categories.
questions.explanation_hindi:
103वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2019 द्वारा अनुच्छेद 15(6) और 16(6) के स्पष्टीकरण में यह साफ किया गया है कि आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्ग (EWS) वे नागरिक होंगे जो अनुच्छेद 15(4), 15(5) और 16(4) में उल्लिखित वर्गों—अर्थात अनुसूचित जातियों (SC), अनुसूचित जनजातियों (ST) और सामाजिक व शैक्षिक रूप से पिछड़े वर्गों (OBC)—के अंतर्गत शामिल नहीं हैं।

कार्मिक एवं प्रशिक्षण विभाग (DoPT) के 31 जनवरी 2019 के कार्यालय ज्ञापन के अनुसार, EWS आरक्षण विशेष रूप से अनारक्षित (सामान्य) वर्ग के उन नागरिकों के लिए है जो एससी, एसटी या ओबीसी आरक्षण के दायरे में नहीं आते हैं और जिनकी सकल पारिवारिक वार्षिक आय ₹8.00 लाख से कम है।

इस प्रकार, जो व्यक्ति पहले से ही एससी, एसटी या ओबीसी श्रेणी में आते हैं, वे ईडब्ल्यूएस आरक्षण का दावा करने के पात्र नहीं हैं, ताकि किसी को भी दो अलग-अलग ऊर्ध्वाधर श्रेणियों के तहत दोहरा लाभ न मिले।
questions.topic: Constitutional Provisions for PwBD, EWS, SC, ST, and Disadvantaged Groups
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) General category citizens not covered under SC, ST, and OBC quotas

questions.question_english: A charged officer refuses to submit their written statement of defense and ignores all summons to attend the inquiry. The Inquiry Officer proceeds ex-parte and concludes the inquiry. Which of the following statements is true regarding this scenario?
options_english: The ex-parte inquiry inherently violates natural justice because the employee was not personally heard.
The IO is legally required to wait indefinitely until the charged officer chooses to appear in person.
The Disciplinary Authority cannot legally impose any major penalty based on an ex- parte inquiry report.

questions.explanation_english: The ex-parte inquiry is valid as reasonable opportunity was provided but not availed. Natural justice requires providing a reasonable opportunity of defense, not forcing an employee to participate. questions.question_english: Which statutory apex authority developed and launched the 'POCSO e-Box' to provide a direct online reporting mechanism for children facing sexual abuse?
options_english: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) panel
Ministry of Education (MoE) Child Protection Department
Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) Academic Board
National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR)
questions.explanation_english: The 'POCSO e-Box' (Electronic Box) was developed and launched by the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR), a statutory body established under the Commissions for Protection of Child Rights (CPCR) Act, 2005. questions.question_english: If a settlement is arrived at through conciliation under Section 10 of the POSH Act, what is the mandatory next step for the ICC?
options_english: Record settlement, notify employer, and share copies with parties
Conduct a full departmental inquiry despite the recorded settlement agreement
Forward the settlement agreement directly to the local police station
Keep the settlement strictly confidential and take no further administrative action
questions.explanation_english:
Section 10 of the POSH Act, 2013 sets forth the sequential steps to be executed upon the successful completion of conciliation:
1. Recording the Settlement (Section 10(2)): The Internal Committee or Local Committee must formally record the terms of the settlement arrived at between the parties.
2. Forwarding to Employer (Section 10(2)): The committee forwards the recorded settlement to the employer (or District Officer) to implement actions as specified in the recommendations.
3. Furnishing Copies (Section 10(3)): The committee must provide authenticated copies of the recorded settlement to both the aggrieved woman and the respondent.
4. Inquiry Barred (Section 10(4)): Once a valid conciliation settlement is recorded, no further inquiry shall be conducted into the complaint by the ICC.

Note: If the respondent fails to comply with the terms of the settlement, Section 11(1) proviso allows the ICC to re-open the case and proceed with a full inquiry. Hence, Option (A) is the correct answer.
questions.explanation_hindi:
पॉश अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 10 में सुलह समझौता होने के बाद की वैधानिक प्रक्रिया स्पष्ट रूप से दी गई है:
1. समझौते को अभिलिखित करना: धारा 10(2) के अनुसार, आंतरिक शिकायत समिति (ICC) दोनों पक्षों के बीच हुए समझौते के सभी नियमों एवं शर्तों को लिखित रूप में दर्ज (रिकॉर्ड) करेगी।
2. नियोक्ता को प्रेषित करना: समिति इस समझौते की रिपोर्ट नियोक्ता (विद्यालय प्रबंधन/सक्षम प्राधिकारी) को भेजेगी ताकि की गई सिफारिशों के अनुसार आवश्यक प्रशासनिक कदम उठाए जा सकें।
3. पक्षकारों को प्रतियां प्रदान करना: धारा 10(3) के अनुसार, समिति समझौते की प्रति व्यथित महिला तथा प्रत्यर्थी दोनों को अनिवार्य रूप से प्रदान करेगी।
4. अग्रिम जांच पर रोक: धारा 10(4) के तहत सुलह हो जाने पर समिति द्वारा कोई अग्रिम विभागीय जांच नहीं की जाएगी (यद्यपि धारा 11(1) के परंतुक के अनुसार यदि आरोपी समझौते की शर्तों का उल्लंघन करता है, तो जांच पुनः शुरू की जा सकती है)।

अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Record settlement, notify employer, and share copies with parties

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: share copies with parties Upon reaching a settlement through conciliation under Section 10, the committee must record the agreed terms, forward the settlement record to the employer to take recommended actions, and provide copies to both parties. Once conciliation is completed, no further departmental inquiry into the complaint is conducted by the committee.

questions.question_english: What is meant by a "Nil TDS Return" in the context of statutory tax compliance by a Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO)?
options_english: A return filed by an educational institution that does not possess a valid PAN or TAN
A return filed when an employee claims a complete refund of tax deducted during the year
A quarterly TDS statement filed by a deductor declaring zero tax deduction during the relevant quarter
A special tax return filed exclusively by non-profit educational or charitable organizations
questions.explanation_english: A "Nil TDS Return" refers to a quarterly tax statement submitted by a registered deductor (such as a school DDO having a TAN) indicating that no tax was deducted at source during that specific quarter. This situation typically arises when payments made to deductees or employees fall below statutory tax thresholds (e.g., employee salaries remaining within the basic exemption limit under Section 192, or vendor payments within the Section 194C threshold). While deductors can also file a 'Declaration for non-filing of TDS return' via TRACES if no taxable payments occurred, in statutory practice, submitting a quarterly statement declaring zero deduction confirms that the deductor was operational and had zero tax liability to remit for that quarter.
questions.explanation_hindi: "शून्य टीडीएस विवरणी" (Nil TDS Return) से तात्पर्य किसी पंजीकृत कटौतीकर्ता (जैसे टैन धारक विद्यालय का DDO) द्वारा दाखिल किए जाने वाले ऐसे त्रैमासिक विवरण से है, जिसमें यह प्रमाणित किया जाता है कि संबंधित तिमाही के दौरान स्रोत पर कोई कर कटौती (TDS) नहीं की गई है। ऐसी स्थिति सामान्यतः तब उत्पन्न होती है जब कर्मचारियों या संविदाकारों को किए गए भुगतान निर्धारित कर-योग्य सीमा से नीचे रहते हैं (जैसे धारा 192 के तहत कर्मचारियों का वेतन मूल छूट सीमा से कम होना या धारा 194C की सीमा के भीतर होना)। यद्यपि कटौतीकर्ता TRACES पर विवरणी दाखिल न करने का घोषणा-पत्र भी दे सकते हैं, किन्तु शून्य कटौती दर्शाने वाला यह विवरण यह पुष्ट करता है कि उक्त तिमाही के लिए कटौतीकर्ता की कोई टीडीएस देनदारी नहीं थी। अतः विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_english: A government-aided school management dismisses a permanent teacher without holding a formal inquiry or providing an opportunity to be heard. questions.explanation_english: Article 14 embodies the fundamental right against arbitrariness in state action and incorporates the principles of natural justice. key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Article 14

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Article 14 embodies the fundamental right against arbitrariness in state action and incorporates the principles of natural justice. Terminating a permanent employee without holding an inquiry or providing an opportunity to be heard in a state-funded institution constitutes arbitrary action, directly violating Article 14 guarantees.

questions.question_english: If a government school teacher wishes to appeal against the penalty imposed upon him by the disciplinary authority based on the ICC's inquiry report under the POSH Act, where must he file the appeal?

To the designated appellate authority under the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965

questions.explanation_english: Under Section 18(1) of the POSH Act, 2013, any person aggrieved by the recommendations made by the Internal Committee under Section 13, or by the implementation/non-implementation of penalties by the employer, may prefer an appeal to the court or tribunal in accordance with the provisions of the service rules applicable to that person. For government school teachers and employees (such as those in Kendriya Vidyalayas, Navodaya Vidyalayas, and Delhi Administration), the applicable service rules governing discipline and penalties are the Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1965 [CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965]. Consequently, an aggrieved employee must submit the statutory appeal before the designated Appellate Authority specified in the schedule of the CCS (CCA) Rules, within the prescribed limitation period.

questions.question_english: Which of the following best describes the role of an Inquiry Officer (IO) during disciplinary proceedings?

questions.question_english: Read the situation below and answer the question that follows: A recognized private unaided school in Delhi claims minority status based on religion to avoid implementing the 25% EWS/DG quota mandated by the RTE Act. What is the constitutionally correct position regarding this claim?
options_english: Unaided minority schools must fulfill the 25% quota as they operate on land allotted by the government.
Only aided minority schools are exempt from the RTE mandate.
All private schools, without exception, must implement the 25% quota under Article 21A.
Unaided minority schools are exempt from the RTE mandate of 25% EWS reservation.
questions.explanation_english: In Pramati Educational and Cultural Trust (2014), the Supreme Court held that the RTE Act, including its mandatory 25% EWS quota, does not apply to minority educational institutions (both aided and unaided) covered under Article 30(1), as enforcing it would infringe upon constitutional rights granted to minorities.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर D है। प्रमती एजुकेशनल एंड कल्चरल ट्रस्ट (2014) निर्णय के अनुसार RTE अधिनियम का 25% EWS कोटा अनुच्छेद 30(1) के अंतर्गत संरक्षित अल्पसंख्यक शैक्षणिक संस्थानों पर लागू नहीं होता। इसलिए यदि विद्यालय विधिसम्मत रूप से अल्पसंख्यक संस्थान है, तो केवल RTE अधिनियम के इस कोटे के आधार पर उसे गैर-अल्पसंख्यक निजी विद्यालय जैसा दायित्व नहीं दिया जा सकता। यह निष्कर्ष संस्थान के वास्तविक अल्पसंख्यक दर्जे और लागू कानूनी स्थिति पर निर्भर करेगा।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Unaided minority schools are exempt from the RTE mandate of 25% EWS reservation.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In Pramati Educational and Cultural Trust (2014), the Supreme Court held that the RTE Act, including its mandatory 25% EWS quota, does not apply to minority educational institutions (both aided and unaided) covered under Article 30(1), as enforcing it would infringe upon constitutional rights granted to minorities.

questions.question_english: In the context of the Income Tax Act, 1961, which section specifically mandates the employer to deduct tax at source (TDS) on the estimated income of an employee under the head 'Salaries'?
options_english: Section 194C
Section 194J
Section 192
Section 201
questions.explanation_english: Section 192 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 specifically governs the deduction of tax at source on payments made under the head 'Salaries'. It mandates that any person responsible for paying any income chargeable under the head 'Salaries' shall deduct income tax at the time of payment on the estimated total income of the employee at the average rate of income tax computed on the basis of applicable slab rates. In contrast, Section 194C applies to payments to contractors, Section 194J applies to fees for professional or technical services, and Section 201 deals with the consequences of failure to deduct or pay tax.
questions.explanation_hindi: आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 192 विशेष रूप से 'वेतन' मद के अंतर्गत किए जाने वाले भुगतानों पर स्रोत पर कर कटौती (TDS) का प्रावधान करती है। इसके अनुसार, नियोक्ता/DDO वित्तीय वर्ष के दौरान कर्मचारी की अनुमानित वार्षिक आय पर लागू औसत कर दर के आधार पर प्रत्येक माह वेतन भुगतान के समय टीडीएस की कटौती करता है। धारा 194C ठेकेदारों के भुगतानों पर, धारा 194J व्यावसायिक या तकनीकी सेवाओं के शुल्क पर तथा धारा 201 कर कटौती न करने या जमा न करने के परिणामों से संबंधित है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Section 192

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Section 192 of the Income Tax Act 1961 mandates every employer responsible for paying income under the head salaries to deduct tax at source. The deduction is calculated on the estimated total income of the employee for the financial year using the average rate of tax applicable to the corresponding income tax slabs.

सामाजिक और शैक्षिक रूप से पिछड़े वर्ग (SEBCs)

questions.question_english: Which specific communities are explicitly highlighted in Article 46 of the Constitution of India alongside the general phrase "the weaker sections of the people"?
options_english: Minorities and Anglo-Indians
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBCs)
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)
questions.explanation_english:
The exact constitutional text of Article 46 of the Constitution of India reads:
'The State shall promote with special care the educational and economic interests of the weaker sections of the people, and, in particular, of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes, and shall protect them from social injustice and all forms of exploitation.'

Key Constitutional Nuances:
1. Dual Focus: While the opening phrase encompasses all 'weaker sections of the people' (enabling broad socio-economic welfare policies, scholarships for poor students, nomadic tribes, and economically disadvantaged groups), the Article gives express, paramount emphasis to 'the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes'.
2. Positive Duty: It mandates that the State must act with 'special care' in promoting their educational and economic development, which provides constitutional legitimacy to schemes like Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS), Post-Matric Scholarships for SC/ST students, and special coaching initiatives in public schooling systems.
questions.explanation_hindi:
भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 46 का मूल संवैधानिक पाठ इस प्रकार है:
'राज्य, जनता के दुर्बल वर्गों के, और विशेषतया, अनुसूचित जातियों तथा अनुसूचित जनजातियों के शिक्षा और अर्थ संबंधी हितों की विशेष सावधानी से अभिवृद्धि करेगा और सामाजिक अन्याय तथा सभी प्रकार के शोषण से उनका संरक्षण करेगा।'

प्रमुख संवैधानिक बारीकियां:
1. दोहरा दृष्टिकोण: यद्यपि यह अनुच्छेद 'जनता के दुर्बल वर्गों' (weaker sections) को शामिल करता है (जिसके आधार पर घुमंतू जनजातियों, निर्धन छात्रों आदि के लिए कल्याणकारी योजनाएं बनाई जाती हैं), किंतु यह विशेष रूप से 'अनुसूचित जातियों (SC) तथा अनुसूचित जनजातियों (ST)' पर सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता के साथ बल देता है।
2. सकारात्मक कर्तव्य: यह राज्य पर 'विशेष सावधानी' (special care) से उनके शैक्षिक और आर्थिक हितों को बढ़ावा देने का दायित्व सौंपता है। यही प्रावधान एकलव्य मॉडल आवासीय विद्यालय (EMRS), SC/ST पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति और सरकारी स्कूल प्रणालियों में विशेष कोचिंग योजनाओं का संवैधानिक आधार बनता है।
questions.topic: Constitutional Provisions for PwBD, EWS, SC, ST, and Disadvantaged Groups
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Article 46 of the Constitution of India explicitly directs the State to promote with special care the educational and economic interests of the weaker sections of the people, and in particular, of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes. It places a constitutional duty on government authorities to ensure their social upliftment.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following duties and measures prescribed for educational institutions under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016:
I. Providing reasonable accommodation according to the individual's requirements.
II. Providing transportation facilities to children with disabilities and to the attendants of children with high support needs.
III. Ensuring early detection of specific learning disabilities and taking pedagogical measures to address them.
IV. Supplying specialized uniforms free of cost to all students with disabilities.
Which of the duties given above are legally mandated under the Act?
options_english: I, II and III only
I, III and IV only
II, III and IV only
I, II, III and IV
questions.explanation_english:
Statements I, II, and III are statutory mandates under Chapter III (Education) of the RPwD Act, 2016, whereas Statement IV is not:

- Statement I is correct: Section 16(iii) requires institutions to 'provide reasonable accommodation according to the individual's requirements'.
- Statement II is correct: Section 16(viii) mandates institutions to 'provide transportation facilities to the children with disabilities and also the attendant of the children with disabilities having high support needs'.
- Statement III is correct: Section 17(d) directs the appropriate government and local authorities to establish mechanisms to 'detect specific learning disabilities in children at the earliest and take suitable pedagogical and other measures to overcome them'.
- Statement IV is incorrect: While Section 16(vii) mandates the supply of books, learning materials, and appropriate assistive devices free of cost up to the age of 18 years, the statute does not mandate supplying 'specialized uniforms free of cost'.
questions.explanation_hindi:
कथन I, II और III दिव्यांगजन अधिकार अधिनियम, 2016 के अध्याय III (शिक्षा) के अंतर्गत कानूनी रूप से अनिवार्य हैं, जबकि कथन IV अधिनियम में सम्मिलित नहीं है:

- कथन I सही है: धारा 16(iii) के अनुसार प्रत्येक बच्चे की व्यक्तिगत आवश्यकता के अनुसार समुचित वास-सुविधा (Reasonable accommodation) प्रदान करना अनिवार्य है।
- कथन II सही है: धारा 16(viii) स्पष्ट रूप से आदेश देती है कि शिक्षण संस्थान 'दिव्यांग बच्चों को तथा उच्च सहायता की आवश्यकता वाले बच्चों के सहायकों (attendants) को भी परिवहन सुविधाएं प्रदान करेंगे'।
- कथन III सही है: धारा 17(d) सरकार और स्थानीय प्राधिकरणों को यह दायित्व सौंपती है कि वे बच्चों में विशिष्ट अधिगम अक्षमता (SLD) की शीघ्र पहचान करें तथा उपयुक्त शैक्षणिक उपाय अपनाएं।
- कथन IV गलत है: धारा 16(vii) के तहत 18 वर्ष की आयु तक निःशुल्क पुस्तकें, शिक्षण सामग्री और उपयुक्त सहायक उपकरण (Assistive devices) प्रदान करने का दायित्व है, परंतु 'निःशुल्क विशिष्ट वर्दी' प्रदान करने का कोई विधिक आदेश नहीं है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I, II and III only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Section 16 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act of 2016 mandates educational institutions to provide reasonable accommodation, ensure suitable transportation facilities for children with disabilities, and conduct periodic screenings for early detection of learning disabilities. Providing specialized uniforms free of cost is not a statutory duty prescribed under this specific section of the Act.

questions.question_english: When a school engages local contractors for civil works or maintenance and deducts TDS under Section 194C, which statutory quarterly return must the DDO use to report these non-salary tax deductions?

questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 31A of the Income Tax Rules, Form 26Q is the prescribed statutory quarterly return for reporting Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on all resident payments other than salaries. When a school Principal/DDO pays resident vendors or contractors (e.g., for repairs, security, cleaning, transport, civil maintenance) and deducts tax under Section 194C (or Section 194J for professional services), the quarterly filing must be done via Form 26Q. In contrast, Form 24Q is strictly for salaries (Section 192), Form 27Q is for non-resident deductees, and Form 16A is the quarterly TDS certificate issued to the vendor (not the return itself).
questions.explanation_hindi: आयकर नियम 31A के अनुसार, 'फॉर्म 26Q' (Form 26Q) भारत में निवासी व्यक्तियों/फर्मों को किए गए सभी गैर-वेतन भुगतानों (जैसे धारा 194C के तहत ठेकेदारों, धारा 194J के तहत व्यावसायिक सेवाओं आदि) पर काटे गए टीडीएस की त्रैमासिक विवरणी दाखिल करने के लिए निर्धारित फॉर्म है। विद्यालय में मरम्मत, रखरखाव या अन्य सेवाओं के बिलों से काटे गए टीडीएस का विवरण फॉर्म 26Q में दाखिल किया जाता है। इसके विपरीत, फॉर्म 24Q कर्मचारियों के वेतन (धारा 192) के लिए है, फॉर्म 27Q अनिवासी व्यक्तियों के लिए है, और फॉर्म 16A ठेकेदार को जारी किया जाने वाला प्रमाण-पत्र है।

questions.question_english: Which specific statutory enactment criminalizes the act of intentionally insulting or intimidating with intent to humiliate a member of a Scheduled Caste or a Scheduled Tribe in any place within public view (including educational institution and school premises)?
options_english: Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955
Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
Right to Education Act, 2009
Indian Penal Code Section 153A
questions.explanation_english: The Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (POA Act), as amended in 2015, is a specialized criminal legislation enacted to prevent offenses and atrocities against members of SC and ST communities. Specifically, Section 3(1)(r) of the Act prescribes stringent penal consequences for anyone (not being a member of an SC or ST) who intentionally insults or intimidates with intent to humiliate a member of a Scheduled Caste or a Scheduled Tribe in any place within public view. Educational institutions, including government, aided, or private schools, playgrounds, corridors, and classrooms accessible to peers or public, constitute places 'within public view'. The Act provides for specialized Special Courts, non-bailable arrest provisions, and mandatory compensation for victims. In the context of school administration, school heads and teachers must ensure zero tolerance for caste-based abuses, pejorative remarks, or discriminatory behavior, as failure to report or active participation attracts criminal culpability under this Act.
questions.explanation_hindi: अनुसूचित जाति और अनुसूचित जनजाति (अत्याचार निवारण) अधिनियम, 1989 (SC/ST Act) की धारा 3(1)(r) [2015 संशोधन के अनुसार] यह स्पष्ट प्रावधान करती है कि यदि कोई व्यक्ति, जो अनुसूचित जाति या अनुसूचित जनजाति का सदस्य नहीं है, किसी SC या ST सदस्य को 'सार्वजनिक दृष्टिगोचर' (Public view) किसी भी स्थान पर अपमानित करने के आशय से जानबूझकर अपमानित या भयभीत करता है, तो वह एक संज्ञेय और गैर-जमानती अपराध करता है। विद्यालय परिसर, खेल का मैदान, कक्षाएं और गलियारे कानूनी रूप से 'सार्वजनिक दृष्टिगोचर स्थान' के दायरे में आते हैं। विद्यालय प्रमुखों एवं शिक्षकों पर यह कानूनी दायित्व है कि वे परिसर में किसी भी प्रकार के जाति-आधारित ताने, मौखिक दुर्व्यवहार अथवा अपमानजनक व्यवहार को रोकें। ऐसा न करने पर संबंधित कर्मचारियों व अधिकारियों के विरुद्ध भी कठोर दंडात्मक कार्रवाई की जा सकती है। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_english: Pursuant to the amendments made to the POCSO Act in 2019, what is the statutory minimum punishment prescribed for Aggravated Penetrative Sexual Assault under Section 6?
options_english: 7 years rigorous imprisonment
10 years rigorous imprisonment
20 years rigorous imprisonment
Life imprisonment without the possibility of parole
questions.explanation_english: The POCSO (Amendment) Act, 2019 significantly enhanced the punishment for Aggravated Penetrative Sexual Assault under Section 6. Prior to the amendment, the minimum punishment was 10 years rigorous imprisonment. Following the 2019 amendment, Section 6 provides that whoever commits aggravated penetrative sexual assault shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than twenty years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life (meaning remainder of that person's natural life), and with fine, or with death. Thus, the statutory minimum penalty is now 20 years of rigorous imprisonment.
questions.explanation_hindi: पॉक्सो (संशोधन) अधिनियम, 2019 द्वारा धारा 6 के तहत गुरुतर प्रवेशन लैंगिक हमले के लिए दंड को अत्यंत कठोर कर दिया गया है। 2019 के संशोधन से पूर्व इस अपराध के लिए न्यूनतम सजा 10 वर्ष का कठोर कारावास थी। संशोधित धारा 6 के अनुसार, जो कोई भी गुरुतर प्रवेशन लैंगिक हमला करेगा, उसे कम से कम बीस वर्ष के कठोर कारावास से दंडित किया जाएगा, जिसे आजीवन कारावास (उस व्यक्ति के प्राकृतिक जीवन के शेष समय तक कारावास) और जुर्माने तक, या मृत्युदंड से भी दंडित किया जा सकेगा। अतः वर्तमान में वैधानिक न्यूनतम सजा 20 वर्ष का कठोर कारावास है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (c) 20 years rigorous imprisonment

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Criminal Law Amendment and POCSO Amendment Act of 2019 enhanced penalties for aggravated penetrative sexual assault under Section 6. The minimum punishment was increased from ten years to twenty years rigorous imprisonment, extending up to imprisonment for life or the death penalty in severe statutory cases, alongside a mandatory fine.
